raw.buffDescription: If the Attacker hasn't landed an attack in [16982bff]8[-] seconds, the Defender gains a Rampage Charge until they are struck. Rampage grants [16982bff]+100%[-] Attack rating, causes Skirmish & Warfare Charges to slowly deplete & causes the Defender to fight more aggressively.
